result.scope: Same original TRAIN128, same selected26 intervention cohort, same hardware/scoring; change implicit command QP/prediction only. No student learning, no generalization claim.

native_command_audit.scope: Independent first-episode command-history mapping check, not a dynamics or recovery certificate

old_controller_breakdown.scope: Recorded native feedback execution. Prediction errors occur on each controller own states; not a paired model counterfactual. Wall time is not injected physical latency.

new_controller_breakdown.scope: Recorded native feedback execution. Prediction errors occur on each controller own states; not a paired model counterfactual. Wall time is not injected physical latency.

old_controller_contact_timing.scope: Temporal ordering only; a later support rejection does not explain the earlier physical collapse. Prediction errors are recorded on each controller own states, not paired counterfactuals.

new_controller_contact_timing.scope: Temporal ordering only; a later support rejection does not explain the earlier physical collapse. Prediction errors are recorded on each controller own states, not paired counterfactuals.

paired_prediction_diagnostics.scope:
Compare held-command predictions with the next recorded native state.

Uses actual executed targets, not hindsight control selection. Samples every
20th recorded first-episode tick. Contact changes and bound violations remain
visible; better joint prediction alone is not a valid support certificate.
paired_prediction_diagnostics.state_source: reconstructed public observations with recorded support modes; not exact native solver state

coordinate_audit.scope:
Check dataset eligibility, total-command/history mapping and expressibility.

No policy training or teacher-off evaluation. Existing legacy residual bounds
are not relabelled: the checked native-delta coordinate is explicitly new.

condensed_substep_audit.scope: Existing commands on reconstructed recorded states; unsaturated affine model checked against independent substeps. No new optimized actions or native execution.
